info.name: AllisWell REST API v1.9.0
info.description:
Generated from the AllisWell OpenAPI spec — see https://alliswell.space/docs/api

Set `apiKey` to a personal key (Settings → API access and management) and `workspaceId` to the workspace it belongs to; `GET /api/v1/me` lists yours. The few endpoints a key may not open are marked and use `sessionJwt` instead.
